title: Scheduled release buffers and stability cohort orchestration for cross-surface launches
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Recent quarters exposed frequent cross-surface launch collisions (runtime, console, API) that caused overloaded Dedicated pools and ad-hoc rollbacks. Our current release calendar is event-centric and lacks explicit "buffer windows" and cohort gating primitives that operations, platform, and product teams can depend on.

Objective: Define schedule primitives and an orchestrator pattern that enforces scheduled buffer windows, cohort-based gating, and capacity hedges across runtime/console/api release trains. Deliver an operational playbook, a calendar-as-code generator for launch slots, and signals/telemetry to automatically recommend safe launch lanes.

Why now: Increasing cadence (more canaries, quantization rollouts, console UX updates) combined with constrained Dedicated capacity requires deterministic coordination. This work supports OKR: "Stability-first launch cadence" and reduces emergency rollbacks ahead of our next enterprise ramp.

Scope: Product-facing scheduling rules, handoff contract for Eng/Infra (capacity reservations & blackout lanes), Console UI affordances for slot reservation, and a release-train orchestration spec consumed by Launch Conductor. Does NOT include implementing infra-level auto-scaling (separate infra epic).

Deliverables:
- Release calendar primitives doc (buffer definitions, minimum reserve windows, cohort definitions)
- Calendar-as-code generator (template + config schema) and example pipeline that outputs a weekly slot map
- Playbook: slot reservation flow, escalation paths, and cutover checklist per launch lane
- Console mock for slot reservation + capacity visualization (handoff to Design/Console PM)
- Telemetry recipe: collision detection alerts, slot utilization metrics, and pre-flight capacity check API

Success metrics:
- Reduce overlapping high-impact launches (same customer-impacting lane) by >= 70% within first quarter of rollout
- Decrease emergency rollback events tied to quota/capacity by 50% for coordinated launches
- 90% of launches use reserved slots (vs ad-hoc) within 2 months of policy enforcement

Stakeholders: PM (owner), Release Conductor, Runtime infra leads, Console PM & Design, Dedicated capacity SREs, Solutions Engineering (enterprise customer comms).
acceptance_criteria: Documented primitives and slot schema published in Confluence with examples
Calendar-as-code templates checked into infra repo and basic generator CI that produces a weekly slot map
Console mock approved by Console PM and Design with path to implementation backlog
Runbook with escalation and rollback thresholds signed off by SRE and Release Conductor
Telemetry dashboard wireframe and alert thresholds reviewed with Observability team
